subject: prior for item parameters in 2 dimensional model

messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: prior for item parameters in 2 dimensional model
parts:
Hi Phil

I need an example of prior distribution for item parameters (slop and location) in  2 dimension model. do you have a example for it? i can not find any example in 'mirt' manual for it.


Best

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: prior for item parameters in 2 dimensional model
parts:
Use the mirt.model() syntax. First, locate what the parameter will name will be for the item (a1 for slope 1, a2 for slope 2, and probably d for the intercet), use the PRIOR keyword, and specify which item(s) this prior should be included for. The examples all follow the same general form. 

Phil

messages.subject: Re: prior for item parameters in 2 dimensional model
parts:
Thank, based on your description i made bellow one. do you confirm it?

mod <- mirt.model('
F1 = 1-55
F2 = 56-110
START = (GROUP, COV_21, 0.76')
PRIOR =(1-55, a1, lnorm, .2, .2), (56-110, a2, lnorm, .2, .2), (1-110, d, norm, 0, 1)')
